dialog.onboardingTitle: Help your AI teacher understand you
dialog.profileLabel: Write what you want your AI teacher to remember about you
dialog.profilePlaceholder: Example: You can call me Alex. I live in Shanghai and studied business administration at university. Since graduating, I have had a regular office job, mostly organizing documents, writing emails, and making spreadsheets. I do not have a technical background and have limited time after work, but I have always wanted to build something of my own. Recently, I hope to use AI to organize my ideas and fill gaps in my knowledge, turning my observations about city life and work into useful articles and small tools, and gradually developing a personal project I can pursue for years. New terminology and complicated wording can easily overwhelm me. I prefer my AI teacher to use a friendly, direct, conversational, and concise language style that is not too formal and avoids unnecessary jargon.

dialog.reassurance: You do not need to write everything at once. Start with what matters most, then add to or change it at any time.
